articles.title: TIME's Kid of the Year Is Helping First Responders Comfort Children in Crisis
articles.summary: Inspired by his own experiences with autism, 9-year-old Ledger Mann created emergency comfort kits for children in crisis. His idea has now spread to six states.

articles.title: What Making a Film About Iran Taught Me About Power
articles.summary: Iran is a country oppressed by its laws. It is also a country full of people who have become extraordinarily adept at navigating them.
